sql: SELECT e.event_date::text AS data, to_char(e.event_date, 'Dy') AS dia, (e.event_date - current_date) AS faltam, coalesce(e.child_name, e.title) AS crianca, e.child_age AS idade, e.status, e.unit, (l.whatsapp IS NOT NULL AND length(regexp_replace(l.whatsapp, '\D', '', 'g')) >= 10) AS tem_whats, coalesce(l.name, '-') AS responsavel, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_history h WHERE h.lead_id = e.lead_id AND h.action = 'Pedido Vamu 3D') AS ja_pediu FROM company_events e LEFT JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = e.lead_id WHERE e.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND e.event_date >= current_date + 15 AND e.event_date <= current_date + 120 AND coalesce(e.status, '') NOT ILIKE '%cancel%' ORDER BY e.event_date
